title: Yellow Zone Audit and Final Hardening
repo_context: Audit 10 yellow-zone correctness points after semantic-index-polish run; document/address gaps (primarily model identity and compaction strategy)

stories.title: Audit all 10 yellow-zone points and document findings
acceptance_criteria: Create AUDIT.md in run directory listing all 10 points with status (COMPLETE/PARTIAL/MISSING)
Each point includes: status, evidence (file paths + line numbers), and gap description if applicable
Findings are objective and reference specific code locations
stories.notes: This creates a durable artifact documenting the audit results. Should reference specific files/line numbers as evidence.

stories.title: Document model identity semantics decision in manifest system
acceptance_criteria: Add inline documentation to manifest.py explaining model identity approach (friendly name vs immutable revision)
Document why current approach (friendly name only) is sufficient and when it would need revision tracking
Documentation explains staleness detection logic and its limitations
stories.notes: Point 4 from yellow-zone brief. Current implementation uses friendly names consistently; document this decision and rationale.

stories.title: Document tombstone compaction strategy in semantic lane agents.md
acceptance_criteria: Strategy includes: what tombstones are, why they exist, when compaction is needed, how to trigger it
Strategy defines clear conditions (e.g., tombstone ratio > X%, index size > Y GB, periodic maintenance)
Strategy includes implementation approach (rebuild index from metadata, preserve chunk_ids)
stories.notes: Point 7 from yellow-zone brief. Document the strategy without implementing compaction itself.

stories.title: Final verification that all 10 yellow-zone points are addressed
acceptance_criteria: Review AUDIT.md and confirm all 10 points are either COMPLETE or explicitly documented/addressed
All existing semantic lane tests pass (pytest backend/retrieval/lanes/semantic/ -v)
No regressions introduced in any of the 8 previously complete points
Update AUDIT.md final section with overall status summary
stories.notes: Final validation that the yellow zone is fully hardened and ready for next phase.
